name: Pipecat
summary: Pipecat is an open-source Python framework for building realtime voice and multimodal agents as pipelines of STT, LLM, TTS and transport services. It is built and maintained by Daily, which also runs Pipecat Cloud for hosting. Client SDKs cover web, mobile and C++.
facts: Python; clients for JS, React, React Native, iOS, Android, C++
goodFor: Voice agents deployed on any infrastructure
watchOut: Fast release cadence; v1.0 came with a migration guide
